`{% if no_related_material %}...{% endif %} · {% if enforcement_disabled ... %}`
`{{ target.canonical_id }} · {{ target.pin_status }} · pinned {{ target.pinned_fingerprint }} · current {{ target.current_fingerprint or "missing" }}`
The distinct status facts are visually delimited by '·' rather than structured markup (e.g., list items or labeled fields).
advisory.finding: The plan-review phase transition is conveyed with a bare '→' (U+2192 RIGHT ARROW) glyph and no textual equivalent, so assistive technologies may announce it inconsistently (e.g., 'right arrow', 'right pointing arrow', or nothing), obscuring the signed→required phase relationship.
merged_from: Status details in the health summary paragraph and target rows are separated by bare '·' (middot) glyphs used as visual delimiters; screen readers may read these aloud ('middle dot') or skip them, causing the concatenated pin/phase/floor values to run together without clear boundaries.
scenarios: A screen-reader user reviewing the audit ticket page to understand plan-review phase status.
